cuhkAdmission.introduction: Embracing the Era of Artificial Intelligence Artificial Intelligence (AI) is an emerging engineering discipline that focuses on technological innovations that enable computing systems to behave and discover new knowledge with human-like intelligence. It is a broad area that covers many specializations, such as machine learning, deep learning, knowledge representation/inference, large-scale computing systems and distributed systems, logic/constraint programming, human-computer interaction, natural language processing and big data analytics. It has evolved in multiple disciplines, including finance, medicine, manufacturing, robotics, multimedia, telecommunications and computational linguistics, and there is now a huge demand for AI specialists both locally and globally. But there are critical challenges regarding how to innovate and design solid and rigorous solutions for AI, as well as how to properly address the related ethical and societal issues. With the support of a pool of top-tier AI talent and sophisticated scientific research facilities, our programme – Artificial Intelligence: Systems & Technologies (AIST) – aims to equip students with the capability to design and implement AI systems and technologies that can analyse, reason about and infer knowledge from massive information, backed by a rigorous foundation of mathematics, basic sciences, data structures, statistics, algorithms, distributed computing, and so forth. Graduates will be capable of applying AI in various disciplines, such as finance, medicine, manufacturing, robotics, multimedia, telecommunications and computational linguistics, and develop research skills for making cutting-edge innovations in AI that are of practical interest to academia, industry and society. The AIST programme emphasizes fundamental mathematics, sciences and theoretical knowledge, and complements this knowledge with practical systems and skills. Students can choose from four optional specialized streams according to their interests: Biomedical Intelligence Intelligent Multimedia Processing Large-scale Artificial Intelligence – Theory and Systems Intelligent Manufacturing and Robotics
cuhkAdmission.ranking: #7 globally in Artificial Intelligence (#1 in Hong Kong) (US News and World Report Best Global Universities by Subject in 2025)
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: As there is now a shortage of AI specialists both locally and globally, with the support of a pool of top-tier AI talent and sophisticated scientific research facilities, our programme aims to train talented AI engineers and scientists for the following industries: biomedical engineering/science, information and computing technologies, manufacturing and robotics, and intelligent multimedia processing for Internet companies. Outro The AIST programme aims to admit high-calibre students who demonstrate outstanding ability in English, mathematics and science subjects. An excellent academic background and a problem-solving mindset are essential for understanding AI knowledge and tackling future challenges with AI. If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW

admission.title: Admission Requirements
content: Tuition fee: HK$47,000 per annum (local students)
Subject weighting: English (x1.25), Chinese (x1.25), Mathematics (x1.75), M1/M2 (x1.75), Biology/Chemistry/Physics/ICT (x1.5)
- Two elective subjects: Level 3 each (including M1/M2, Biology, Chemistry, ICT, Physics preferred)

curriculum.title: Curriculum Overview
content: The AIST programme equips students with capabilities to design and implement AI systems that analyse, reason about, and infer knowledge from massive information, backed by rigorous foundations in mathematics, basic sciences, data structures, statistics, algorithms, and distributed computing.
Students can choose from four optional specialised streams:
- Large-scale Artificial Intelligence – Theory and Systems

The curriculum emphasises fundamental mathematics, sciences and theoretical knowledge, complemented by practical systems and skills. Graduates develop cutting-edge AI solutions of practical interest to academia, industry and society.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: There is a huge demand for AI specialists both locally and globally. Graduates are trained for careers in:
- Intelligent multimedia processing for Internet companies
The programme aims to train talented AI engineers and scientists who can apply AI in finance, medicine, manufacturing, robotics, multimedia, telecommunications and computational linguistics.

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK's Shatin campus offers a vibrant college system with nine colleges, each providing residential, pastoral and cultural experiences.
Students benefit from state-of-the-art research facilities and a collaborative environment with top-tier AI talent.
The programme is supported by sophisticated scientific research facilities and a pool of world-renowned AI researchers.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
content: The programme is highly selective, with strong emphasis on Mathematics and science electives.

alumni.title: Alumni & Faculty Excellence
content: The programme launched in 2022; the first cohort has yet to graduate.
Faculty includes world-renowned AI researchers such as Prof. Michael R. Lyu and Prof. Irwin King.
Strong industry partnerships with Google, Microsoft, and local AI startups provide students with internship and research opportunities.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: CUHK offers a range of entrance scholarships based on academic merit for local and non-local students, covering tuition fees and living expenses in some cases.
Local JUPAS students may be eligible for admission scholarships, the Tertiary Student Finance Scheme (TSFS), and the Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (NLSPS).

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS4468 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: Aim for a Best 5 score of at least 52.375 (median). With subject weighting, focus on Mathematics (x1.75) and M1/M2 (x1.75) to maximise your total.
- Use the CUHK admission score calculator to simulate your weighted score.
Mathematics Compulsory and M1/M2 are weighted at 1.75 each. A 5* in both can add significant points.
- If you are strong in Maths, consider taking M1 or M2 to boost your application.
Both languages are weighted at 1.25. A Level 4 or above in English is required, but higher grades improve your score.
- Practice reading comprehension and essay writing to secure Level 5 or above.
Biology, Chemistry, ICT, and Physics are preferred subjects and weighted at 1.5. Taking two of these can strengthen your profile.
- If you are interested in Biomedical Intelligence, Biology is especially relevant.
The programme requires an interview. Demonstrate your problem-solving mindset and passion for AI.
- Review common AI concepts and be ready to discuss your projects or interests.
All 28 offers in 2025 went to Band A applicants. Placing JS4468 in Band A is critical for consideration.
- Use Band A to signal strong interest and maximise your chance.
Beyond DSE, participate in maths or science competitions, AI workshops, or online courses (e.g., Coursera AI specialisations).
- Highlight any relevant projects in your interview or personal statement.
Familiarise yourself with the four specialised streams: Biomedical Intelligence, Intelligent Multimedia Processing, Large-scale AI, and Intelligent Manufacturing.
- Choose a stream that aligns with your career goals to tailor your learning.
Read about latest AI advancements (e.g., large language models, robotics). This shows genuine interest during interviews.
- Follow CUHK CSE news and faculty research to connect your application to the programme.

curriculum.title: 課程概覽
content: 人工智能：系統與科技課程旨在培養學生設計和實施人工智能系統的能力，使其能夠分析、推理並從大量信息中推斷知識，並以數學、基礎科學、數據結構、統計學、算法和分佈式計算的嚴謹基礎為支撐。
學生可根據興趣選擇四個專業分流：
- 大規模人工智能——理論與系統
課程強調基礎數學、科學和理論知識，並輔以實踐系統和技能。畢業生能開發對學術界、工業界和社會具有實際意義的前沿人工智能解決方案。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 本地及全球對人工智能專才的需求極大。畢業生可從事以下行業：
- 互聯網公司的智能多媒體處理
課程旨在培養優秀的人工智能工程師和科學家，能夠將人工智能應用於金融、醫學、製造、機器人、多媒體、電信和計算語言學等領域。

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 香港中文大學的沙田校園設有九所書院，提供住宿、關顧及文化體驗。
學生可享用先進的研究設施，並與頂尖人工智能人才協作。
課程獲世界知名人工智能研究人員和精密科研設施支持。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力
content: - Band A 每錄取申請人數：約 2.9
入學分數（最佳五科）：中位數 52.375，下四分位數 50.375，上四分位數 55.75
課程競爭激烈，尤其重視數學和科學選修科。

alumni.title: 校友及教研成就
content: 課程於 2022 年開辦，首屆學生尚未畢業。
教研團隊包括世界知名的人工智能研究人員，如呂榮聰教授和金國慶教授。
與 Google、Microsoft 及本地人工智能初創企業有緊密的行業合作，為學生提供實習和研究機會。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 香港中文大學為本地及非本地學生提供多項基於學術成績的入學獎學金，部分涵蓋學費及生活費。
本地 JUPAS 學生可申請入學獎學金、專上學生資助計劃（TSFS）及免入息審查貸款計劃（NLSPS）。

tips.title: Ace Sir 的 JS4468 策略 — 9 個可行貼士
content: 爭取最佳五科至少 52.375 分（中位數）。利用科目比重，重點提升數學（x1.75）和 M1/M2（x1.75）以最大化總分。
- 使用中大入學分數計算器模擬你的加權分數。
數學必修部分和 M1/M2 比重均為 1.75。兩科取得 5* 可大幅增加分數。
- 若數學能力強，可考慮選修 M1 或 M2 以提升申請競爭力。
**3. 在英文和中文上表現出色**
兩科語文比重均為 1.25。英文需達第 4 級或以上，更高級別可提高分數。
- 練習閱讀理解和寫作，爭取第 5 級或以上。
生物、化學、資訊及通訊科技和物理是優先科目，比重為 1.5。選修其中兩科可強化個人檔案。
- 若對生物醫學智能分流感興趣，生物科尤其相關。
課程需要面試。展示你的解難思維和對人工智能的熱情。
- 複習常見人工智能概念，並準備討論你的項目或興趣。
**6. 在 Band A 中申請**
2025 年所有 28 個錄取名額均來自 Band A 申請者。將 JS4468 放在 Band A 至關重要。
- 利用 Band A 表達強烈興趣，最大化機會。
除文憑試外，參加數學或科學比賽、人工智能工作坊或網上課程（如 Coursera 人工智能專項課程）。
- 在面試或個人陳述中突出相關項目。
熟悉四個專業分流：生物醫學智能、智能多媒體處理、大規模人工智能、智能製造與機器人。
- 選擇與職業目標一致的分流，以定制學習內容。
閱讀最新人工智能進展（如大型語言模型、機器人技術）。這能在面試中展示真正興趣。
- 關注中大計算機科學與工程學系的新聞和教師研究，將你的申請與課程聯繫起來。
